senses.gloss:
मिल् मिलति pp. मिलित (q.v.) meet, assemble, join
(instr. ±सह, gen., or loc.), mix, combine;
 occur, happen. C.
मेलयति bring together with (gen.), assemble (tr.). — सम् come
together, be present, get into possession of (gen.).
मीलन n. closing the eyes, winking.
मिलित a. met, joined, happened, occurred.
